problems: missing_required: required target /product_name is not mapped

open_questions: No SKU-like header found in root table; using 'Material code' as identity — confirm

notes: Table 0 (Material) supplies the master population and the /product_name values; table 1 (Price history) supplies /price and /currency and must be joined to table 0 on Material code.
'Material code' reports as int type with zero-padded display values (000001…000012); it must be cast to string so leading zeros are preserved for /sku.

Rows are filtered by three source conditions per the operator requirement: Price list = RETAIL, Currency = THB, and Valid from <= 2026-11-03 <= Valid to (inclusive bounds). This should leave one price row per material code (12 records).
WHOLESALE/USD rows (valid 2026-01-01 to 2026-10-31) are expired and excluded by that filter.
The source contains no VAT-inclusion indicator or tax rate; no VAT adjustment is inferred from convention.

tables.reason: Sheet 'Material' is a clean master list of 12 unique material records: one 'Material code' and one 'Description' per row, no duplicates, no prices or quantities. This supplies the product population and identity.

columns.name: Material code
columns.reason: Header 'Material code', 12 distinct values across 12 rows (unique key), SKU-like values with zero padding (000001…000012). Contract requires /sku as string preserving leading zeros, so it must be mapped as text, not integer.

columns.name: Description
columns.reason: Header 'Description', 12 distinct free-text product names (e.g. 'Coffee variant 01', 'Soap variant 11') matching one per material code; this is the master product name required by /product_name.

tables.reason: Sheet 'Price history' holds 48 price records: each material code appears 4 times (one per price list / currency / validity period combination), with a 'Selling price' column and validity dates. Operator requirement restricts output to RETAIL, THB, valid on 2026-11-03 inclusive.

columns.name: Material code
columns.reason: Header 'Material code', 12 distinct values matching the Material master, 4 rows each — foreign key joining price rows to the product list; must be read as text to preserve leading zeros.

columns.name: Price list
columns.reason: Only two values: RETAIL (36 rows) and WHOLESALE (12 rows). Not a target field; used as a filter — operator requires RETAIL only.

columns.name: Currency
columns.reason: Values THB (36 rows) and USD (12 rows), ISO 4217 codes; operator requires THB only, so this column both supplies /currency and filters rows.

columns.name: Valid from
columns.reason: Date values 2026-11-01 (36 rows) and 2026-01-01 (12 rows). Not a target field; used as validity-range filter — record must be active on 2026-11-03.

columns.name: Valid to
columns.reason: Date values 2026-11-30 (36 rows) and 2026-10-31 (12 rows). Not a target field; upper inclusive validity bound for selecting the record valid on 2026-11-03.

columns.name: Selling price
columns.reason: Header 'Selling price' (not cost), numeric, 43 distinct values ranging 2–256; the requested selling price for /price. VAT inclusion is not stated in the source, so it is not assumed.

evidence: root table: sheet 'Price history' (48 rows) classified as products
